summary: Introduction to the ansible-core 2.14 porting guide describing changes from ansible-core 2.13, to be read with the 2.14 changelog.
questions: Where do I start when upgrading to ansible-core 2.14?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.13 → 2.14 overview
answer_card.answer_md: The ansible-core **2.14** porting guide lists behaviour changes since **2.13** that may require updates to playbooks, plugins and other content. Read it together with the ansible-core 2.14 changelog.
